input.summary: Invoice INV-01561 (CAD 2,520.00, dated 2026-10-09) looks like a duplicate of AP-00370, which has the same invoice number and amount and is already settled. That earlier invoice was paid by Brim card charge CT-00556 on 2026-10-11 for CAD 2,520.00, so paying this one would likely pay the same bill twice. Cloudbarn Software Inc. is active on a fixed monthly contract (C001), and this invoice has no approval decisions recorded. Two other CAD 2,520.00 invoices are also open in October: INV-01567 (AP-00411, scheduled) and INV-01568 (IN-EM-046-1, pending approval).
